status: actual registered source schemas; handlers not executed for schema capture

tools.name: live2d_begin_model
tools.description: Begin creating a complete editable Live2D character from a brief and the user’s actual resources. Artwork, rigging, native compilation and motion review are production stages; inspectors remain diagnostics.

tools.name: live2d_model_layer
tools.description: Import one independently painted complete part after MAIN-session native image creation/review; complete_part=true attests to complete hidden backing and refuses flat portrait slices. This is an attestation, not automated proof. Preserve hidden backing and neutral identity; do not treat interlocked portrait slices as complete parts. Names are unique per model. Parts are either full-canvas PNGs sharing one canvas size, or cropped PNGs with integer x and y placement on that canvas. For an opaque single-flat-colour image, supply key_color as [R,G,B] or [] to detect from corners; the tool performs a conservative cutout and returns a before/after preview. trim requires x and y. For a same-canvas reference edit set same_canvas_edit=true and reference_path to verify and correct high-confidence drift; low confidence preserves its coordinates and requests a nudge.

tools.name: live2d_model_rig
tools.description: Save authored rig source, omit source for static export, or pass source=prototype-roll for experimental head roll, basic torso sway/breathing and provisional blink/gaze and mouth opening when matching parts exist. Experimental back-hair physics is included when hair is present; neither route supplies XY turns or mouth form.

tools.name: live2d_build_model
tools.description: Build with the configured Umamo toolchain when using the static layer export, or run an explicitly selected real native authoring command; requires actual MOC3/model3 output. Trusted toolchain code executes; use only the resource/paths authorized for this production. Missing compiler stays blocked.

tools.name: live2d_render_model_motion
tools.description: Render the built model through a selected actual SDK/Core renderer into a real motion MP4 for MAIN-session review. No physical camera/tracker/VTS integration is part of this operation.

tools.name: live2d_model_status
tools.description: Read actual model production layers/rig/compiled package/motion state, never a fabricated ready flag.

tools.name: live2d_reference_samples
tools.description: List the official free Live2D sample models this plugin knows (Hiyori, Haru, Mark, Mao, Ren) with their official pages, whether each is already in the plugin's data folder, and the licence links. With sample_id, summarise that present sample's structure (parameters, parts, physics, expressions, motions) as a reference.

tools.name: live2d_fetch_reference_sample
tools.description: Download one official free Live2D sample from Live2D's own sample-data host into this plugin's data folder, only as a structural reference. Requires accept_licence=true, which means you showed the user what is being downloaded and the licence links and the user agreed. Reuses a present sample.

tools.name: live2d_inspect_resources
tools.description: Inspect model3.json references for missing or unsafe model, texture, physics, expression and motion resources. This does not inspect or render the rig.

tools.name: live2d_check_motion
tools.description: Check Cubism motion curve structure and compare targets with supplementary display-info IDs without rendering.

tools.name: live2d_open_model
tools.description: Open an EXISTING compiled runtime model only (not an editable layer project; use live2d_clone_model to copy a plugin-owned layer project). Open an EXISTING Live2D model (the .model3.json the user already has, or the folder that holds it; give a full absolute path) as a working copy inside a new project, so it can be inspected, changed and rendered. The original files are never modified. Use this when the user already has a character; use live2d_begin_model to create a new one.

tools.name: live2d_inspect_model
tools.description: Describe an opened model in plain terms: controls, expressions, motions, physics groups (what drives what, how strongly) and, when the Cubism renderer is available, the separate parts and drawable pieces and each control range.

tools.name: live2d_adjust_physics
tools.description: Change how loose parts (hair, tentacles, skirt) swing in an opened copy or built project: multipliers for output strength, how strongly head/body motion drives them, and follow-through (swing that continues after the head stops). Applied to the saved original each time, not compounded. restore_original undoes it.

tools.name: live2d_write_motion
tools.description: Write a new motion (for example an idle that makes her breathe, sway, look around and blink) into an opened copy or built project from plain curve descriptions, validated against the model’s real parameter ids and ranges, and register it as the Idle motion. tracks: list of {parameter, wave:sine (center, amplitude, cycles = whole number per loop, optional phase 0-1) | blink (at: [seconds], optional closed_seconds, open_value, closed_value) | keys ([[seconds, value], ...] eased)}. The structural check runs automatically.

tools.name: live2d_render_clip
tools.description: Render the opened or built model moving through the official Cubism Core (physics running) into a labelled motion clip. motion: a motion name from the model or one you wrote; left out it plays the model’s own Idle motion (how she moves now), or standard if it has none; standard = test sequence (head turns left and right, blinks, small body sway); rest = no motion. Same camera and length every time so before/after clips compare directly. Look at the contact sheet in the main session.

tools.name: live2d_set_canvas
tools.description: Set a shared neutral canvas without changing artwork; every placed part must fit.

tools.name: live2d_place_layer
tools.description: Adjust layer placement, position, offset, move or scale an imported part on the shared canvas without resampling artwork; rebuild and render to apply.

tools.name: live2d_check_rig_domains
tools.description: Evaluate each actual Core parameter at minimum, default and maximum, check finite geometry and report movement. This does not review intermediate poses or visual quality.

tools.name: live2d_configure_umamo
tools.description: Configure an existing installed Java and Umamo toolchain using a user-supplied JSON file with compiler and runtime path arrays. No installation occurs.

tools.name: live2d_arrange_layers
tools.description: Arrange all imported complete layers back to front before building; list every layer name exactly once.

tools.name: live2d_default_layout
tools.description: Propose or apply rough role-based placement from the actual face bounds and requested head count when no reference is available. Inspect the composite; defaults are not visual acceptance.

tools.name: live2d_register_layer
tools.description: Propose position and scale by bounded image matching against a full-figure reference. Applies a candidate only above the strict confidence threshold; inspect the composite and give a placement nudge if confidence is low.

tools.name: live2d_rebuild_prototype
tools.description: Rebuild an experimental prototype using the current built-in authoring recipe after an observed geometry issue, preserving earlier builds. Render the same motion and compare; rebuilding does not guarantee a visual fix.

tools.name: live2d_clone_model
tools.description: Copy a plugin-owned EDITABLE LAYER PROJECT including its source layers and evidence for a reversible repair; do not use live2d_open_model, which copies a compiled runtime only. The source project stays unchanged.

tools.name: live2d_remove_layer
tools.description: Remove a layer from the active assembly without deleting its source PNG or previous builds; rebuild to apply.
